variants.headline: Bid to remove government fails
variants.body: A vote to bring down the government has failed in {colony}. This gazette considers the stewardship of {target} inadequate and regards the matter as warranting critical scrutiny.

variants.headline: Confidence challenge falls short
variants.body: The attempt to remove the government by an Assembly vote has failed. This gazette considers the stewardship of {target} inadequate and regards the matter as warranting critical scrutiny.

variants.headline: Government survives the Assembly test
variants.body: The government has survived a vote intended to bring it down. This gazette considers the stewardship of {target} inadequate and regards the matter as warranting critical scrutiny.
